notes: Production application of the already-approved NARA rubric-to-criterion mappings. This is distinct from the NARA source-native risk_assessment_claims backfill: composite NARA risk levels remain external risk assessments, while only individually approved rubric observations become criterion_claims. Run with --dry-run first and review counts before applying. Source-level replacement is required so stale NARA criterion claims are superseded when approved mappings or NARA source rows change.
